scientific_integrity: No independent audit was performed; finite verification is not an infinite proof; primary literature is attributed.
scientific_limitations: The hypothesis is sufficient, not necessary; only second integral homology is classified. The comparison theorem from Jamil and Behrens is used as prior literature. Higher cubical homology and short-cycle factors are not classified. A cited unpublished monophobic-neighborhood manuscript could contain overlapping material.
title: Aspherical square fillings control second discrete cubical homology
